Home.h1: Medicare Advisor in New Orleans, Louisiana
Home.lede: Personal, in-person help choosing the right Medicare plan — from a local husband-and-wife team who will be here for you year after year.
Home.reassurance: No cost to you. No pressure. Se habla español.
Home.teamCaption: Nidia & John Martinez · Licensed agents · Husband-and-wife team
Home.productsIntro: We explain your options in plain language, compare plans side by side, and help you enroll. Our help is at no cost to you.

one.title: Call or send a message
one.body: Tell us a little about what you need. We'll set up a time that works for you — in person, by phone, in English or Spanish.

two.title: Review your options together
two.body: We look at your doctors, prescriptions and budget, then compare plans side by side in plain language.

three.title: Enroll with confidence
three.body: We help with the paperwork and stay available all year for questions, claims help and your annual review.

Home.ctaHeading: Let's find the right plan for you
Home.ctaBody: Call us or send a short message. A licensed local agent will get back to you soon.
Home.officeBody: Bring your list of doctors and prescriptions, and we'll go through your options together, at your pace, in English or Spanish. Prefer to talk by phone? That works too.
Home.officeAppointment: Visits are by appointment. Call {phone} to set up a time.

Aep.preBody: Your Annual Notice of Change (ANOC) should arrive by the end of September. It lists how your plan will change for {coverageYear}. Book your review early so you have time to compare.
Aep.openTitle: Annual Enrollment is open now — through December 7
Aep.openBody: This is your chance to review your plan for {coverageYear}. Happy with it? It renews automatically. Unhappy with the changes? Let's review your options in person.

Scam.heading: Beware of Medicare scams
Scam.body: Be cautious of unsolicited calls, texts or emails about Medicare.

points.one: Never give your Medicare number or personal information to someone who contacts you out of the blue.
points.two: Don't enroll over the phone with a stranger. Hang up and call a local agent you know.
points.three: Not sure? Call us — Nidia at {nidiaPhone} or John at {johnPhone}. We'll help you check.
